title: TrustedCode: Evaluating Large Language Models for Developing Trusted Code through Automated Program Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.30432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent reports, such as "Who is using AI to code?", indicate that approximately 30\% of Python code contributions to GitHub are AI-generated. Given the inherent unreliability of this code, formal verification emerges as a promising approach to establish trust in software correctness. Although leveraging large language models (LLMs) for formal verification has garnered increasing attention, practical adoption remains limited due to the challenges in writing formal specifications and verifying program correctness against them. Existing tools predominantly support verification for languages such as Java and C, with minimal support for Python. We present TrustedCode, an automated framework for verifying AI-generated Python code. TrustedCode uses LLMs to (i) type-check Python code, (ii) translate it into WhyML via the Why3 framework, and (iii) verify it against formal specifications using Why3 back-end automated theorem provers. translated_abstract: 近期报告（如《谁在使用AI编写代码？》）指出，GitHub上约30%的Python代码贡献是由AI生成的。鉴于这类代码固有的不可靠性，形式化验证成为建立软件正确性信任的一种有前景的方法。尽管利用大语言模型（LLM）进行形式化验证日益受到关注，但由于编写形式化规范以及依据规范验证程序正确性存在困难，其实际应用仍然有限。现有工具主要支持Java和C等语言的验证，对Python的支持很少。我们提出了TrustedCode，一个用于验证AI生成的Python代码的自动化框架。TrustedCode使用大语言模型来：(i) 对Python代码进行类型检查，(ii) 通过Why3框架将其转换为WhyML，(iii) 使用Why3后端的自动定理证明器依据形式化规范对其进行验证。我们的方法在……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出TrustedCode自动化框架，利用大语言模型对AI生成的Python代码进行类型检查、通过Why3框架转换为WhyML，并借助Why3后端的自动定理证明器依据形式化规范完成验证，从而建立对软件正确性的信任。
en_tdlr: TrustedCode is an automated framework that uses LLMs to type-check AI-generated Python code, translate it into WhyML via the Why3 framework, and verify it against formal specifications with Why3's automated theorem provers, establishing trust in software correctness.
